navaid.name: Seacow Head Light
navaid.description: The Lighthouse from the TV series "Road to Avonlea" (https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0098900/)

navaid.name: Walton Harbour Lighthouse and Museum
navaid.description: Originally kerosene, no longer operating. The interior is a museum open to the public in season. Light room is accessible and still has the clockwork wind-up mechanism that rotated the light. Gift shop next door is sometimes open, picnic tables.

navaid.name: Front Range Light
navaid.description: Moved to this site when the light was decommissioned in 2013.
